title: How US kids got to school in 2009: walking/biking vs. being driven

source.name: National Household Travel Survey, school-travel comparison
source.publisher: Safe Routes to School National Partnership / FHWA NHTS

notes: In the same NHTS comparison, private-vehicle drop-offs rose from 12% of school trips in 1969 to 44% in 2009, overtaking walking and biking as the dominant way US kids get to school. Verified live via web search 2026-11-11.
